library(DT)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

sheetname = "1fbxi0gsUxb9lJgli9LJL8PNKSwWiMvHx8UfjvMNzuuQ"
sheetname2 = "StockData"
url <-  paste0("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/",sheetname,"/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=",sheetname2)
place <-  read.csv(url)
place <<- place

sheetname = "1riSYdnvql9O5OkVBlVEAw1ic3_gG0iRDxePvXP0KCyw"
sheetname2 = "ocean"
url <-  paste0("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/",sheetname,"/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=",sheetname2)
oceanData <<-  read.csv(url)

ui = fluidPage(
  fluidRow(
    plotlyOutput("chart"),
    DTOutput("datatable")
  )
)
server = function(input, output,session) {
  output$chart = plotly::renderPlotly({
    data = place %>% filter(Symbol %in% "MSFT")
    fig <- plotly::plot_ly(data, x = ~Date, y = ~Price, name = 'Price', type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines',
                   line=list(color=c('gray'),dash = "solid"))
    fig
    })
  
  output$datatable = DT::renderDataTable({
  ocean = oceanData[,1:10]
  datatable(ocean)})
  }
shinyApp(ui, server, options = list(launch.browser = TRUE,port = 2030))
